description: This file implements a FastAPI router for payment-related endpoints, including creating checkout sessions, handling webhooks, and retrieving payment history (both user and admin views). It defines data schemas, integrates with environment variables for Stripe configuration, and includes stub implementations for payment provider interactions.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a checkout request, including amount, currency, and optional reference.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when creating a checkout, including provider info, session IDs, payment status, and message.

classes.name: PaymentItem
classes.description: Schema representing a payment record, including ID, reference, amount, currency, status, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: PaymentsListResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of payments, containing total count and item list.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_provider_keys()
methods.description: Retrieves Stripe secret and webhook keys from environment variables.

methods.name: PaymentItem _to_item(p: Payments)
methods.description: Converts a Payments ORM object to a PaymentItem schema.

methods.name: CreateCheckoutResponse create_checkout( payload: CreateCheckoutRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a payment intent or checkout session (stub). Returns placeholders or real data if environment variables are set.

methods.name: dict stripe_webhook( request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db), stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Stripe-Signature"), )
methods.description: Stub webhook endpoint for processing Stripe events, updating payment status accordingly.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse payment_history( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of current user's payment records.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse admin_payments( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by status (pending/success/failed/refunded)"), user_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by specific user"), )
methods.description: Admin-only view for listing all payments with optional filters.
